name: @kickside/models-ui
title: KickSide Models
description: Models and provider-profile admin web component for kickside/models.

wippy.description: Admin surface for LLM providers and the model catalog, mounted by the host as <kickside-models> with no props. A rail lists connected provider profiles, the main pane shows the searchable model pool and class catalog, and a right-docked drawer hosts provider and model editing through the models admin API. The same bundle registers declarative provider-profile editor tags. A separate onboard.js entry ships <kickside-onboard-models>; it connects a provider, assigns default models per class, and reports whether class:fast is backed by an enabled usable profile so later system setup may safely use optional model assistance.
